headline: A conditional-independence limit for confidence-ranked parallel diffusion sampling
summary: The authors analyze independent-update samplers that choose parallel token writes using per-position distributions and sample each selected position independently. They claim that matching the training joint distribution at a step requires the written positions to be conditionally independent given fixed tokens, and that per-position marginals alone cannot certify this condition. On their synthetic ScanAndAdd task, they report confidence-ranked writes with perfect sample-level validity metrics but a generated token distribution about 29 times the sampling-noise-floor total variation. The theorem is conditional on the sampler class; the measured distortion is from one synthetic task and is not evidence that deployed diffusion models exhibit the same magnitude of error.
